topic: Duplicate Lead Handling: Tags and Logic
summary: The system automatically identifies duplicate leads based on configured fields (e.g., phone number). Special tags, 'Duplicate' and 'Duplicate Primary', are used to manage these. 'Duplicate Primary' marks the first instance of a lead, while subsequent leads with the same identifying information are marked 'Duplicate'.
steps: 1. Navigate to Admission Setup > Admission Master > Admission Tags.
3. Enter the tag name exactly as 'Duplicate' (no leading/trailing spaces).
8. Change all Hex color values to '0' (zero out RGB components).
1. Navigate to Admission Setup > Admission Master > Admission Tags.
3. Enter the tag name exactly as 'Duplicate Primary'.
6. Change all Hex color values to '0' (black).
business_rules: When a new lead is added with the same identifying field (e.g., phone number) as an existing lead, the system will pop up a warning.
The first lead created with a specific identifying field will be automatically tagged as 'Duplicate Primary'.
Any subsequent leads created with the same identifying field will be automatically tagged as 'Duplicate'.
important_notes: The 'Duplicate Primary' tag is crucial for identifying the original lead among multiple duplicates.
Ensure the 'Duplicate' tag is named exactly 'Duplicate' and its color is set to black (all zeros in Hex) for proper system functionality.
Ensure the 'Duplicate Primary' tag is named exactly 'Duplicate Primary' and its color is set to black (all zeros in Hex) for proper system functionality.
